sentences.text:
The case of the petitioners as set out in the writ petition is that their land bearing Arazi No. 14/3 area 0.122 hectare was acquired by notification under Section 3D of the National Highways Act,
1956 and award was also made in respect of the said land.
4.

The respondent-revenue authorities, however, carried out some correction in the revenue record,
as a result whereof, the land of the petitioners, which was acquired, has now been numbered in the revenue records as Arazi No. 14/1.
5.
Learned counsel for the petitioners states that on account of said confusion created by the revenue authorities, compensation amount has not been released in their favour.

6. Sri Devendra Kumar, learned counsel appearing for N.H.A.I. is in receipt of instructions,
according to which, the land notified for acquisition was Gata No. 14/3.
Compensation for the said plot was deposited before the competent authority in the year 2008.

It is also the stand of N.H.A.I.
that Gata No. 14/1 is not affected by the widening of the road.
7. On the other hand, we find that there is a communication dated 19th September, 2020 by competent authority addressed to Project Director, N.H.A.I.
It refers to the application filed by the petitioners mentioning that they have not received compensation for their land so far.

The communication acknowledges that in the meeting dated 06.03.2017 held under the chairmanship of A.D.M. (Finance and Revenue), Lalitpur, the rate of compensation was decided, however,
compensation has not been paid so far.
He has also mentioned in the said communication that N.H.A.I. had carried out widening of the road without payment of compensation and the officials of N.H.A.I. are deliberately delaying the matter.

8. It is evident from the stand taken by N.H.A.I. before this Court and the aforesaid communication by the competent authority that they are thrusting responsibility on each other, with the result affected persons are suffering.
9. It is not disputed either by N.H.A.I. or by the State-respondents that the land of the petitioners had got affected as a result of widening of the road.
The petitioners are therefore, entitled to compensation.
The respondents should sort out their differences amongst themselves without any delay.

10. The writ petition is disposed of with direction to N.H.A.I. and Special Land Acquisition Officer,
Lalitpur to sort out their differences and ensure payment of compensation to the petitioners, if there is no other legal impediment, within six weeks from the date of receipt of communication of the instant order.
(Donadi Ramesh, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 18.9.2023
